title: SUUS General Assembly: Induction of new board
description: First SUUS General Assembly of the year, open to FI students and staff. The outgoing board presents its final report on 2025-2026. The incoming board (Chair: Thilo Stausberg, Secretary: Lisa Craane, Treasurer: Jeffrey Waterlander, Communications Officer: Montserrat Dengra Grau) presents its policy plan for 2026-2027 and is sworn in. Free food and drinks; all are welcome.
